Find

(4)

questions.question_text:
A particle $P$ of mass $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ is moving under the action of a constant force $\mathbf{F}$ newtons. The velocity of $P$ is $(2\mathbf{i}-5\mathbf{j})\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$ at time $t=0$, and $(7\mathbf{i}+10\mathbf{j})\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$ at time $t=5\,\mathrm{s}$.

Find
(a) the speed of $P$ at $t=0$,
(2)
(b) the vector $\mathbf{F}$ in the form $a\mathbf{i}+b\mathbf{j}$,
(5)
(c) the value of $t$ when $P$ is moving parallel to $\mathbf{i}$.
(4)
questions.mark_scheme_text:
speed$=\sqrt{2^2+(-5)^2}$ M1
$=\sqrt{29}=5.4$ or better A1
$((7\mathbf{i}+10\mathbf{j})-(2\mathbf{i}-5\mathbf{j}))/5$ M1 A1
$=(5\mathbf{i}+15\mathbf{j})/5=\mathbf{i}+3\mathbf{j}$ A1

$\mathbf{v}=\mathbf{u}+\mathbf{a}t=(2\mathbf{i}-5\mathbf{j})+(\mathbf{i}+3\mathbf{j})t$ M1
$(-5+3t)\mathbf{j}$ A1

$t=5/3$ A1

Initially $B$ is held at rest on a rough fixed plane inclined at angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\tan\theta = \frac{5}{12}$. The part of the string from $B$ to $P$ is parallel to a line of greatest slope of the plane. The string passes over a small smooth pulley, $P$, fixed at the top of the plane. The particle $A$ hangs freely below $P$, as shown in Figure 4. The coefficient of friction between $B$ and the plane is $\frac{2}{3}$. The particles are released from rest with the string taut and $B$ moves up the plane.
